# Offline-First Restaurant POS

> Restaurant point-of-sale built as a PWA that keeps taking orders when the connection drops.

Author: Muhammad Tanveer (Full-Stack AI Automation Engineer)
Contact: mtanveertahir66@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-tanveer-advenno/
Repository: https://github.com/haddindeve/restaurant-pos-offline-first
Source availability: implementation held in a private repository; access on request.

## Summary
A restaurant POS that stops working during an internet outage stops the restaurant. Service continues whether or not the connection does, so the software has to as well.

A React PWA that treats the network as optional: orders are written locally first and synchronised to a Node backend when a connection exists. The kitchen and the till keep a consistent view of an order regardless of connectivity at the moment it was taken.

## Stack
Frontend: React PWA, Backend: Node.js, Offline: Local-first persistence with background sync, Deployment: Render

## Capabilities
- Offline order taking
- Background synchronisation
- Table and menu management
- Kitchen order flow
- Installable on standard tablets

## Outcomes
- Service continues through connectivity loss
- Orders reconcile automatically rather than being re-keyed

## FAQ
Q: What happens during an outage?
A: Orders are written to local storage and synchronised once the connection returns; staff see no interruption.

Q: Does it need special hardware?
A: No - it installs as a PWA on standard tablets.

Q: How are conflicts handled?
A: The sync layer reconciles local and server state on reconnect rather than overwriting blindly.

Q: Is the source public?
A: Private repository.
